title: Spectral stability of shock profiles for the Navier-Stokes-Poisson system
summary: We investigate the spectral stability of small-amplitude shock profiles for the one-dimensional isothermal Navier-Stokes-Poisson system, which describes ion dynamics in a collision-dominated plasma. Specifically, we establish (i) bounds on the essential spectrum, (ii) bounds on the point spectrum, and (iii) simplicity of the zero eigenvalue for the linearized operator about the profile in $L^2$. The result in (i) shows that the zero eigenvalue arising from translation invariance is embedded in the essential spectrum. Consequently, the standard Evans function approach cannot be applied…
